spanish: Y todo vestido y todo utensilio de piel y toda obra de cabras y todo utensilio de madera se pecarán.

findings.issue: Hithpael imperfect 2nd masculine plural: the addressees do the action. «se pecarán» makes the listed goods a 3rd-person subject.
Hithpael stem force is reflexive/middle, not the simple act of sinning. «pecarán» assigns that qal act to the goods.

notes: The four «todo/toda» chains match the repeated כָּל phrases; the mismatch is the verb.
